body:
Ports lean-workspace-template `222bbea` + `947504b`. On a non-draft, non-`agent/*` PR, waits `AGENT_REVIEW_NUDGE_DELAY_SECONDS` (default 180s, cap 300s) and posts a one-time nudge offering a Sepo review (`agent/review` label / `@sepo-agent /review`) and a preview deploy (`sepo-preview` label); skips when a review was already requested or a synthesis exists for the current head.

Ships the workflow, the `post-review-nudge` CLI + `review-nudge.ts` module, their tests, and the supported-workflows docs entry. The source commit's AGENT.md hunk was dropped here — its content lands in the AGENTS.md PR next in the stack.

**Stack 2/5** — depends on #45 (the nudge CLI ships with runtime 0.4.0).
